The '''2025 [[Eliteserien]]''' was the 81st season of top-tier [[Association football|football]] in Norway. This was the ninth season of Eliteserien after rebranding from Tippeligaen.

The season started on 29 March 2025 and ended on 30 November 2025, not including play-off matches.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fotball.no/tema/nff-nyheter/2024/hovedterminliste-2025/|title=Se hovedterminlistene for 2025|website=Fotball.no|access-date=17 December 2024}}</ref>

[[FK Bodø/Glimt|Bodø/Glimt]] were the defending champions. [[Vålerenga Fotball|Vålerenga]] and [[Bryne FK|Bryne]] joined as the promoted clubs from the [[2024 Norwegian First Division]]. They replaced [[Lillestrøm SK|Lillestrøm]] and [[Odds BK|Odd]], who were relegated to the [[2025 Norwegian First Division]].

[[Viking FK|Viking]] won a closely contested championship title by a single point on the last day of the season, earning their 9th overall title, fending off the defending champions Bodø/Glimt. Viking's last title had come 34 years earlier in [[1991_Tippeligaen|1991]]. With the win, Viking earned an entry to the [[2026–27 UEFA Champions League#Play-off round|2026–27 Champions League play-off round]].

==Teams==
Sixteen teams competed in the league – the top fourteen teams from the previous season and two teams promoted from the [[2024 Norwegian First Division|First Division]]. The promoted teams were [[Vålerenga Fotball|Vålerenga]] and [[Bryne FK|Bryne]], who were promoted after respectively 1 and 21 seasons absent. They replaced [[Lillestrøm SK|Lillestrøm]] and [[Odds BK|Odd]], ending their top flight spells of 4 and 16 years respectively.
